strongest_matched_negative_control.title: Can AI Evaluate AI Scientists? A Benchmarking Study of Autonomous Research Generation Systems Using Automated Multi-Model Review
strongest_matched_negative_control.matched_surface: 15 common research proposals with a common multi-model paper-quality evaluation surface
strongest_matched_negative_control.blocking_reason: The matched study evaluates whole-system paper quality, while its own architecture table marks Integrated Review = No for canonical Data-to-Paper and both Sakana systems. Therefore the matched outcome does not exercise Data-to-Paper's canonical native reviewer-revision S3* path.

reviewed_route_classes.blocking_reason: Tasks, models, evaluator surfaces and result shapes differ; one observation is quantitative and the other descriptive-only.
The reviewer/audit organization is benchmark-defined or composed rather than a materially matched comparison of multiple canonical native S3* implementations.
The common paper-quality comparison does not activate the native S3* path of canonical data-to-paper.

closure_claim: Current public evidence contains direct canonical native S3* observations and matched whole-system comparisons, but no materially matched comparison in which multiple canonical native or adapter-preserved complementary-audit paths are actually active and measured.
reopen_when: a public study evaluates two or more independently canonical-linkable systems with their native or adapter-preserved S3* paths active under one matched task/model/evaluator cell
an existing matched study publishes configuration or trajectory evidence proving native S3* activation for multiple canonical systems
an immutable result directly compares discrepancy detection, corrective return and re-verification across multiple canonical systems
do_not_reopen_for: another whole-system paper-quality leaderboard without native S3* path activation
non_claim: This closure is not a zero S3* capability score, not a claim that matched evidence can never appear, and not a ranking. It freezes the reviewed public-evidence state until materially new primary evidence changes the matched-native condition.
